title: Continuity of the mollified set integral y ↦ ∫_F ρ(y − z) dz
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let F ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set, and let ρ : ℝ^N → ℝ be continuous with compact support. Then the function y ↦ ∫_F ρ(y − z) dz is continuous on ℝ^N. The integral is taken with respect to the restricted measure L^N⌞F.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Rn N)) (ρ : Rn N → ℝ), Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → Continuous (fun y : Rn N ↦ ∫ z in F, ρ (y - z))
